page: Microsoft Azure NC288lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features 288 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. It is equipped with 516.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 1.79 GB per vCPU.

The hardware configuration includes a single integrated GPU and a substantial local storage allocation of 15,841 GB on NVMe SSDs. The instance is also premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server is designed for highly parallelized workloads that require massive CPU core counts and GPU acceleration, paired with extensive local high-speed storage. However, the low memory allocation per core represents a tradeoff, making it less suitable for memory-intensive database tasks that require large RAM-to-CPU ratios. Appropriate workloads include GPU-accelerated compute tasks, large-scale data processing, and localized storage-heavy operations.
